FIXTURE_TEXT = '''\
# fixture registry
[[suite]]
name = "alpha"
dir = "alpha"
with = ["pytest", "numpy"]
extras = ["matplotlib", "arviz>=1.0"]
notes = ["alpha note one", "alpha note two"]

with = ["pytest"]

[[suite]]
name = "outer"
dir = "outer"
with = ["pytest"]
pythons = ["3.13", "/usr/bin/python3"]
notes = ["outer note"]
'''

FIXTURE_FILES = {
    'alpha/test_a.py': 'def test_a():\n    pass\n',
    'outer/test_o.py': 'def test_o():\n    pass\n',
    'outer/inner/test_i.py': 'def test_i():\n    pass\n',
}


def fixture_data(text: str = FIXTURE_TEXT) -> dict:
    return tomllib.loads(text)


def fixture_suites(text: str = FIXTURE_TEXT) -> list:
    return parse(fixture_data(text))


def by_name(suites, name):
    return next(s for s in suites if s.name == name)


def make_root(tmp_path: Path, text: str = FIXTURE_TEXT, files=None, git=True) -> Path:
    root = tmp_path / 'repo'
    root.mkdir()
    if git:
        subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', str(root)], check=True)
    (root / 'build').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (root / REGISTRY).write_text(text)
    for rel, body in (FIXTURE_FILES if files is None else files).items():
        p = root / rel
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(body)
    return root


class FakeRunner:
    def __init__(self, codes=None):
        self.codes = codes or {}
        self.calls = []

    def __call__(self, root, run):
        self.calls.append(run.label)
        print(f'RUN {run.label}')
        return self.codes.get(run.label, 0)


def call_main(argv, **kw):
    try:
        return main(argv, **kw)
    except SystemExit as exc:
        return exc.code


def last_line(out: str, err: str) -> str:
    lines = [l for l in err.splitlines() if l.strip()] or [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    return lines[-1]


def with_entry(**overrides) -> dict:
    entry = {'name': 'alpha', 'dir': 'alpha', 'with': ['pytest']}
    entry.update(overrides)
    return entry


BAD_REGISTRIES = {
    'unknown key': {'suite': [with_entry(wiht=['pytest'])]},
    'missing required key': {'suite': [{'name': 'alpha', 'with': ['pytest']}]},
    'wrong type': {'suite': [with_entry(**{'with': 'pytest'})]},
    'duplicate name': {'suite': [with_entry(), with_entry(dir='beta')]},
    'duplicate directory': {'suite': [with_entry(), with_entry(name='beta')]},
    'with without pytest': {'suite': [with_entry(**{'with': ['numpy']})]},
}


def toml_text(data: dict) -> str:
    out = []
    for entry in data['suite']:
        out.append('[[suite]]')
        for k, v in entry.items():
            if isinstance(v, list):
                out.append(f'{k} = [' + ', '.join(f'"{x}"' for x in v) + ']')
            else:
                out.append(f'{k} = "{v}"')
        out.append('')
    return '\n'.join(out)
